# ChatGPT layout recordings

Sanitized completed and streaming snapshots contributed by @rugnasyab in the discussion of [PR #516](https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/516), from `rugnasyab/oracle` branch `fix/chatgpt-thread-dom-2026-09`. Prompts, responses and identifiers are synthetic. The proof blocks external requests, including the example favicon URLs retained in the DOM.

The fixture proof checks the captured markup and variants retaining only one of the two search-unit marker families. Additional synthetic cases cover current model controls, Work history rows, multiline paste and corruption rejection. These fixtures do not replace signed-in live verification.
